title: MT61326: Applied Reliability Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction and overview Review of basic probability: combinatorial
probability, conditional probability, independence, Bayes theorem Review:
random variables, probability laws, common probability distributions â origins
and interrelations Random number generation â Monte Carlo simulation Functions
of random variables; Joint probability distribution: dependence, conditional
distributions, covariance; Joint Normal distribution Reliability â historical
development, applications, different measures of reliability Component
reliability - time to failure, hazard functions, failure, limit states,
computation of failure probability Reliability-based maintenance System
reliability - representation of failure, series and parallel systems,
redundancy, fault trees Probability-based design and reliability-based design
codes Probability-based acceptance criteria, consequence of failure Concepts
of risk, utility Target reliability
